request.subject: PORTRAIT:DWARF:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a steam submarine: the hull becomes one closed fat cigar-shaped hull of the same soot-black riveted iron with light grey bands; remove the paddle wheel; the tall smokestack becomes a low square conning tower with a copper hatch wheel and one short copper funnel puffing a little white steam; two round portholes glowing bright green #2bd94a; a small copper propeller at the stern. Keep the size, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
